headline: TOR @ ATL matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is TOR 3.56 at ATL 4.23, with a projected total of 7.79. Movement read: Both offenses moved up (TOR +0.33, ATL +0.39), so the movement is more about a higher-scoring game environment than a stronger side. The projected total climbed +0.71, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. Pitching context: Kevin Gausman has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.0 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Ernie Clement, Nathan Lukes, Jesús Sánchez, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Austin Riley, Myles Straw because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
